test_title: PYST 52: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

4 and 6
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ee2498bba297a39279203bbd9638c58f354e0d2fc2d8db79c5e25b11859993e.png] 

Given: 4 and 6 

I. 6 + 4 × 8 - 7 = 45

By Interchanging the given two numbers we get:

⇒ 4 + __**6 × 8**__ - 7 = 45

⇒ __**4 + 48**__ - 7 = 45

⇒ 52 - 7</strong
